column1: # Armoury: roadside inns (sw-zajazdy, Jeff 16.10: 'not too dense - the fewer people, the fewer inns'). One row = one inn.
# Generated by tools/zajazdy/zajazdy_gen.py from the geography probe 16.10 (AI routes between fortresses, ROT 8.1.8) and map villages v5
# - do not edit. x/y = the stopping place on the road (where a party enters); bx/by = the building, front_deg = its front (local +Y) yaw.
# Rule (one for the whole world): spacing = 45 x sqrt(40000 / people within 30), clamped to 30..110; no inn below 12000 people,
# none within 10 of a fortress, 5 of a game village, 2.6 of a map village, none beyond the Wall. tiers: 1 common room; 2 + decent
# inn from 45000 people; 3 + good house only at a crossroads from 110000 people. village_id = district whose purse takes the lodging money.
